# ghost/transportr

Search public named-station VBB connections and departures without location access

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/transportr
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/transportr open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/transportr search_station --device <serial> --param query=<query> --param station=<station>
ghost skill run ghost/transportr read_departures --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/transportr search_connections --device <serial> --param origin_query=<origin_query> --param origin_station=<origin_station> --param destination_query=<destination_query> --param destination_station=<destination_station>
ghost skill run ghost/transportr read_connections --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open Transportr with VBB selected and location denied
- `search_station`: Find and verify an explicitly named public VBB station
- `read_departures`: Read the first three complete visible departures from the selected station
- `search_connections`: Search VBB connections between two explicitly named public stations
- `read_connections`: Read three complete visible connection summaries
